title: What to bring to a dream conversation
intro: You only need the dream you remember and the feeling that made you want to ask about it.

sections.heading: The scene
sections.body: Write the setting, people, objects, colors, and movement.

sections.heading: The feeling
sections.body: Notice what stayed in your body after waking.

sections.heading: The question
sections.body: Bring the part you most want to understand.
